Per-origin audit budgets cap sybil flagging. Each identity files at most 3 flags per epoch, staking a 0.10-unit deposit per flag into a haven pool that pays reviewer fees; deposits return only if the flag stands.

A flag must carry a 256-byte sonnet digest citing the flagged txid, weighted by the filer's plume score: entropy over its last 20 targets, so spamming one victim gets near-zero weight.

40 sybils burying one rival stake 12.0 units; if reviewers clear the target, all 12 burn, budgets halve for 6 epochs, and repeat offenders are delisted.
